name: PET / Alu Foil / Polyethylene Laminate
description: Ultra-high barrier three-layer laminate offering near-zero moisture and oxygen permeability. Essential for roasted coffee, milk powder, and long shelf-life dry goods.

name: Metallised PET / LDPE Laminate
mechanical_strength: Good barrier retention and tear resistance
description: High-barrier metallised film laminate providing an effective barrier against light, moisture, and oxidation. The benchmark packaging for biscuits, cookies, and dry snacks.

name: BOPP / Metallised BOPP Laminate
mechanical_strength: High stiffness and print gloss, moderate puncture resistance
description: Crisp, lightweight snack packaging laminate with excellent moisture barrier and good nitrogen-flush gas retention for potato chips and extruded snacks.

name: Micro-Perforated Polypropylene (Produce MAP)
structure: 25µm BOPP with precision laser micro-perforations (50-100µm pore size)
mechanical_strength: High clarity, anti-fog coated, high tear propagation resistance
description: Tailored gas equilibrium film engineered for high-respiration fresh produce like mushrooms, broccoli, and spinach. Prevents moisture condensation and anaerobic odors.

name: Breathable LDPE / LLDPE Produce Film
mechanical_strength: High impact resistance and elongation at break
description: Naturally gas-permeable polyethylene film with favorable CO2:O2 selectivity (approx 4:1). Ideal for moderate respiration produce like tomatoes, peppers, and mangoes.

name: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Film
mechanical_strength: High tensile strength, crinkly texture, good puncture resistance
description: Economical moisture-barrier film for short-to-medium shelf life grains, pulses, and dry bakery goods.

name: Biodegradable PLA / PBAT Bio-Film
mechanical_strength: Moderate tensile strength, silky matte feel
description: 100% commercially compostable film offering moderate gas permeability. Suitable for organic fresh vegetables and short-turnover produce lines.

name: Cast Polypropylene (CPP) Plain Film
mechanical_strength: High clarity, soft feel, moderate moisture resistance
description: General-purpose transparent packaging film for short shelf life confectionery, dry pastas, and textiles.
